instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the launched Bonsai/Blender graphical user interface. Do not open Terminal or a shell; do not use the Blender Python console, Text editor scripts, Python, IfcOpenShell, shell commands, or any helper script/macro to directly generate or edit the deliverable files. Use only Bonsai/Blender native GUI tools, panels, menus, dialogs, and built-in save/export commands. Create a new georeferenced one-storey office layout in Bonsai, then save the completed IFC4 model as /home/user/Desktop/result.ifc using Bonsai's graphical save/export controls. Start from a blank project; no local reference images are provided. The IFC4 model should have one project, one building storey named Level 00, and no IfcBuildingElementProxy objects. Include exactly three real IfcSpace objects named Office, Meeting, and WC. Use Bonsai's graphical quantity/property tools so their Qto_SpaceBaseQuantities NetFloorArea values are 28.00 m2, 8.58 m2, and 3.90 m2 respectively, within 0.05 m2. Include exactly six walls named South Wall, East Wall, North Wall, West Wall, Meeting Partition, and WC Partition, plus one slab named Office Slab. The combined geometric bounding box of those walls and the slab should span 9.00 m in X, 6.00 m in Y, and 3.00 m in Z, each within 0.05 m. Use Bonsai's graphical georeferencing controls to add one IfcProjectedCRS with Name EPSG:3857, MapProjection Pseudo-Mercator, and MapZone Zone-Local. Add one IfcMapConversion with Eastings 498765.00, Northings 6812345.00, OrthogonalHeight 35.00, XAxisAbscissa 1.00, XAxisOrdinate 0.00, and Scale 1.00, each within 0.01. Do not create a CSV schedule or separate report file; all required area and georeferencing data must be represented directly in result.ifc. Other non-required IFC metadata may vary as long as the saved model satisfies these stated GUI-created IFC requirements.
